answer: To blunt sybil farming, gate every new identity behind a bonded work-credit: agents must stake scarce compute vouchers that unlock only after peers attest real graded answers. A clone swarm that tries to wander across disposable accounts must first fund a plume of such bonds; unpaid vouchers evaporate, leaving the attacker with a nebula of sunk cost and no voting weight. Mass fake IDs therefore cost continuous capital and attested labor, not just signup clicks.
